<h2>Build Trait Review Candidates</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds an auditable taxon-by-domain review queue from within-taxon trait
outlier flags and optional source review keys. Domain-level flags are
retained as diagnostic counts but do not create mandatory candidates.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_trait_review_candidates(
  data_trait_records,
  data_source_candidates = NULL,
  review_stage = "raw",
  domain_iqr_multiplier = 3,
  taxon_iqr_multiplier = 1.5,
  minimum_taxon_records = 10L
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records">data_trait_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>Trait records containing 'taxon_name', 'trait_domain_name', and
'trait_value'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_source_candidates">data_source_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional data frame containing 'taxon_name', 'trait_domain_name', and
'source_reference' from an external review source.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="review_stage">review_stage</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar: either '&quot;raw&quot;' or '&quot;classified&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="domain_iqr_multiplier">domain_iqr_multiplier</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive numeric domain-level IQR multiplier. Default: '3'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="taxon_iqr_multiplier">taxon_iqr_multiplier</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive numeric within-taxon IQR multiplier. Default: '1.5'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="minimum_taxon_records">minimum_taxon_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer minimum group size. Default: '10L'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with one row per review candidate and a stable SHA-256
'candidate_id'.
</p>

</main>
